meta.blockTiming: 12000 ms interval mining (12000 ms mirrors Sepolia)
notes: Fresh deployment per run; client wallets are reused across levels, so later levels see a larger note tree and couriers with a record.

Contracts: the final ones of 2026-10-12 (ratings in the clear, orders as minimal proxies, the worker's ciphertexts in an event, the establishment paid by a note in the pool). Payloads: the dApps' late-release format.
Warm-up: 1 unrecorded unit(s) by client 0 before each sweep.
In-process network: clients, provers and the EVM share one Node process.

In-process EDR guard (EDR_GUARD=1, see installEdrGuard): nonce queries, gas estimates and calls use the "latest" block instead of "pending" (14007 queries retagged; each sender has at most one transaction in flight, so the nonce is the same), eth_estimateGas and eth_call run one at a time (0 + 6012), and a full GC runs every second. EDR allocator: MIMALLOC_PURGE_DELAY=0.
